Modifications for Overworld: validate the pinned source hash and descending
frequency order; retain the first 10000 distinct lowercase ASCII a-z words of
length 3 through 24 in original rank order; remove occurrence counts; encode as
an embedded static string array. Reproduce using
cmake/GeneratePredictionVocabulary.ps1 with the pinned source file. No personal
data, application text, learning or runtime dictionary access is incorporated.

Frequency ranks come from subtitles, not a curated general-language dictionary.
The data can include names, slang, offensive language and adult terms. It is not
claimed to be child-safe. No endorsement by the source authors is implied.
No warranty is provided; see the full license.

Distribute this attribution and the full CC BY-SA 4.0 license with builds that
embed the vocabulary. Adaptations of this DATA must retain attribution, identify
changes and comply with ShareAlike. This notice applies only to the separately
identified vocabulary data; it does not grant a license to the application's
code or alter the separately documented third-party speech licenses.
